rejected_workload_experiment_contract.why_warmup: MiLB coverage begins 2019; 2021 is first training target with pre-origin source coverage after the canceled 2020 minor season. 2020 shortened MLB target excluded from fitting by specification, not by errors; baseline retains original historical 2020 workloads.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.fit_rule: Only training target seasons strictly before each origin; final coefficients fit through 2025 and freeze for 2026/2027
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.baseline: Exact v1.43 accepted_ip weighted average with certified historical participation zeros
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.model: P(MLB appearance) x sum over conditional roles of P(role | appearance) x [conditional starts x IP/start + conditional relief appearances x IP/relief appearance]
components: logistic appearance probability including certified nonappearance
three one-vs-rest logistic role models, normalized conditional on appearance
ridge conditional games given role, with role indicator features
ridge start fraction given role weighted by games
ridge IP/start fit to pure-start seasons only, weighted by starts
ridge IP/relief appearance fit to zero-start seasons only, weighted by games
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.mixed_IP_split: No observed start/relief innings split. Mixed roles use pure-role outing-rate estimates; do not invent per-start labels from IP/GS in mixed seasons.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.availability: Appearance probability plus learned conditional games captures reduced usage and nonappearance. Games divided by earlier-role 90th percentile is a descriptive season-usage proxy, NOT medical injury probability. No dated injury labels available.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.capacity: Prior raw MLB plus MiLB innings/games/starts, combined annual workloads, prior peaks and level exposure shares. Physical workload only; no minor performance equivalencies or park adjustments.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.features: Four prior seasons; MLB IP/G/GS, missing flags, starting share, outing length, recency weighted IP and prior role/history. Additional arm uses MiLB and disjoint combined workloads, exposure missing/vintage flags; canceled 2020 MiLB year stays unavailable.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.estimation: Standardize on earlier training rows only; ridge/logistic penalty 10, intercept unpenalized; no hyperparameter search. Rate regression weights capped at 40 outings.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.bounds: P 0..1, conditional G 0..85, GS <=35 and <=G, fraction 0..1, outing IP .1..9; conditional total IP <=250 through proportional opportunity scaling, exposed in audit. No minimum innings floor.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.support: At least 200 known appearance labels, 20 each class, 20 each conditional role, 50 pure-start and 100 pure-relief target seasons. Unsupported component causes whole-arm baseline fallback, never silent partial fit.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.samples: Same baseline MLB-history pitchers and identical known eligible outcomes per arm/metric; unknown labels excluded, no invented event zeros. Minor-only players reported coverage-only.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.future_outputs: 2026 research workload predictions without scoring; 2027 predictions may use 2026 as player history only after decisions/coefficients freeze. No complete skill/count projection replacement.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.minor_level_policy: AAA/AA/A+/A/A- only; source-year/player/organization/level keys unique in these levels. DSL/CPX/R have multiple affiliate rows under collapsed organization labels and are excluded before any model fitting. Combined workload is observed eligible exposure, not a complete career total.
rejected_workload_experiment_contract.input_audit_amendment: Initial ingestion assertion found repeated collapsed keys only at DSL/CPX/R, before fitting/scoring. Restrict physical-capacity inputs to unambiguous full-season/A- rows and retain every excluded source row in an audit.

interpretation: Original gate implementations remain authoritative. New components must pass applicable existing workload and complete-projection safeguards; no reduced threshold, weakened cohort requirement or automatic promotion.
